title: character.json
description: Named individuals — a mage with a name, a voice, and a portrait. Renderer-only content: never loaded by the simulation, never part of contentRevision, for the same reason the audio set is not (contracts §0 makes contentRevision a compatibility gate, and adding a character must not stop two players raiding each other). The simulation's mages hash into this pool; it does not know these records exist.

look.description: Visual description for the art generator, and ONLY that. Distinct from `note`, which is flavour prose for a reader — the first portrait generated came back as Santa Claus because a note about requisition forms in a coat pocket was fed to the generator as costume.

inputHash.description: Hash of the inputs that produced this asset. The forge recomputes it from the character's current fields and marks the asset STALE when they differ — which is how a character stays up to date when a new per-mage detail is added, without anyone remembering to regenerate.
